1.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo Yesu aba i Galilaya, ntiyashakaga kuba i Yudaya, kuko Abayuda bashakaga kumwica.

2.text: Iminsi mikuru y'Abayuda yitwa Ingando yendaga gusohora.

3.text: Nuko bene se baramubwira bati “Va hano ujye i Yudaya, kugira ngo abigishwa bawe barebe imirimo ukora,

4.text: kuko ari nta muntu ushaka kumenyekana wakorera ikintu mu rwihisho. Kuko ukora iyo mirimo, ngaho genda wiyereke abari mu isi bose!”

6.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Igihe cyanjye ntikirasohora, ariko igihe cyanyu gihoraho iteka.

7.text: Ab'isi ntibabasha kubanga, ariko jyewe baranyanga kuko mpamya ibyabo, yuko imirimo yabo ari mibi.

8.text: Mwebweho nimujye muri iyo minsi mikuru, ariko jyeweho sinjyayo ubu kuko igihe cyanjye kitarasohora.”

9.text: Amaze kubabwira ibyo, asigara i Galilaya.

10.text: Ariko bene se bamaze kwikubura bagiye mu minsi mikuru, na we aragenda ariko atari ku mugaragaro, ahubwo nko mu rwihisho.

11.text: Abayuda bamushakira muri ya minsi mikuru bati “Mbese wa wundi ari he?”

12.text: Abantu bamugira impaka cyane, bamwe bati “Ni umuntu mwiza”, abandi bati “Oya, ayobya abantu.”

13.text: Ariko ntihagira umuvuga ku mugaragaro, kuko batinyaga Abayuda.

14.text: Iminsi mikuru igeze hagati, Yesu azamuka ajya mu rusengero arigisha.

15.text: Abayuda baratangara bati “Uyu yakuye hehe ubu bwenge ko atigishijwe?”

16.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Ibyo nigisha si ibyanjye, ahubwo ni iby'Iyantumye.

17.text: Umuntu nashaka gukora ibyo Ikunda, azamenya ibyo nigisha ko byavuye ku Mana, cyangwa yuko mbivuga ku bwanjye.

18.text: Uvuga ibye ubwe aba yishakiye icyubahiro, ariko ushakira Iyamutumye icyubahiro uwo ni we w'ukuri, gukiranirwa ntikuri muri we.

19.text: Mbese Mose ntiyabahaye amategeko? Ariko muri mwe nta wuyumvira. Murashakira iki kunyica?”

20.text: Abantu baramusubiza bati “Ufite dayimoni. Ni nde ushaka kukwica?”

21.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Nakoze umurimo umwe, namwe mwese murawutangarira.

22.text: Mose yabahaye umuhango wo gukeba, (icyakora ntiwakomotse kuri Mose, ahubwo wakomotse kuri ba sokuruza banyu), ndetse mukeba abantu no ku isabato.

23.text: Ubwo umuntu akebwa ku isabato ngo amategeko ya Mose atazirurwa, none kuki mundakarira kuko nakijije umubiri w'umuntu wose ku isabato?

24.text: Mwe guca imanza ku bigaragara gusa, ahubwo muce imanza z'ukuri.”

25.text: Nuko bamwe mu b'i Yerusalemu barabazanya bati “Uwo bashaka kwica si uyu?

26.text: Nyamara dore aravugira ku mugaragaro ko ari nta cyo bamugira! Mbese harya, ni ukuri koko abakuru bacu bemeye ko uyu ari we Kristo?

27.text: Uyu tuzi aho yaturutse, ariko Kristo naza nta wuzamenya aho yaturutse.”

28.text: Nuko Yesu avuga cyane yigishiriza mu rusengero ati “Jyewe muranzi n'aho naturutse murahazi, ariko sinaje ku bwanjye, ahubwo Iyantumye ni iy'ukuri, iyo mutazi.

29.text: Nyamara jyewe ndayizi kuko navuye kuri yo, kandi ari yo yantumye.”

30.text: Nuko bashaka kumufata ariko ntihagira ubihangara, kuko igihe cye cyari kitarasohora.

31.text: Nuko abantu benshi mu bahateraniye baramwizera bati “Harya Kristo naza, mugira ngo azakora ibimenyetso byinshi biruta ibyo uyu yakoze?”

32.text: Abafarisayo bumva ibyo rubanda bamuvugira mu byongorerano, nuko abatambyi bakuru n'Abafarisayo batuma abasirikare ngo bamufate.

33.text: Yesu aherako aravuga ati “Hasigaye umwanya muto nkiri kumwe namwe, hanyuma nkajya ku wantumye.

34.text: Muzanshaka mwe kumbona, kandi aho nzaba ndi ntimubasha kujyayo.”

35.text: Nuko Abayuda baravugana bati “Mbese uyu agiye kujya he, aho tutazamubona? Aho ntagiye kujya mu batataniye mu Bagiriki akaba ari bo yigisha?

36.text: Iryo jambo avuze ni iriki ngo ‘Muzanshaka mwe kumbona’, kandi ngo ‘Aho nzaba ndi ntimubasha kujyayo?’ ”

37.text: Nuko ku munsi uheruka w'iyo minsi mikuru, ari wo munsi uruta iyindi, Yesu arahagarara avuga cyane ati “Umuntu nagira inyota aze aho ndi anywe.

38.text: Unyizera, imigezi y'amazi y'ubugingo izatemba iva mu nda ye, nk'uko ibyanditswe bivuga.”

39.text: Ibyo yabivuze yerekeje ku Mwuka Wera, uwo abamwizera bendaga guhabwa, ariko ubwo Umwuka yari ataraza kuko Yesu yari atarahabwa ubwiza bwe.

40.text: Bamwe muri rubanda bumvise ayo magambo baravuga bati “Ni ukuri uyu ni we wa muhanuzi.”

41.text: Abandi bati “Uyu ni we Kristo.” Ariko abandi bati “Mbese Kristo aturuka i Galilaya?

42.text: Ibyanditswe ntibivuga ngo Kristo azakomoka mu rubyaro rwa Dawidi, aturuke i Betelehemu, ikirorero Dawidi yarimo?”

44.text: Bamwe muri bo bashaka kumufata ariko ntihagira n'umukoza urutoki.

45.text: Nuko ba basirikare basubira ku batambyi bakuru n'Abafarisayo. Na bo barababaza bati “Mubujijwe n'iki kumuzana?”

46.text: Abasirikare barabasubiza bati “Yemwe, ntabwo higeze kuba umuntu uvuga nka we.”

48.text: Hari umuntu n'umwe wo mu bakuru cyangwa mu Bafarisayo wamwizeye?

49.text: Ariko abo bantu batazi amategeko baravumwe.”

50.text: Nikodemo, wa wundi wigeze gusanga Yesu kera, kandi wari umwe wo muri bo arababaza ati

51.text: “Mbese amategeko yacu acira umuntu urubanza, batabanje kumwumva no kumenya ibyo yakoze?”

52.text: Baramusubiza bati “Mbega nawe waturutse i Galilaya? Irebere mu byanditswe, urasanga ko nta muhanuzi uturuka i Galilaya.”[
